protocol.scope: Exact enumeration of the 32 subsets of five defect groups within the frozen historical candidate pool. Each group retains its integer-grade guard and six calibrated/uncalibrated probability guards. A minimal blocking group set means no candidate in this finite pool satisfies those groups but every proper subset has a witness. It is not global infeasibility or a causal finding.
protocol.nearest_candidate: Among structurally eligible candidates passing all five integer grades, report the smallest worst positive probability delta. This is a diagnostic lower bound on uniform probability slack in this fixed pool, not an authorized tolerance, accepted candidate or physical risk bound.

scientific_scope: Exact finite-pool diagnosis of current modeled scenarios; extra probability guards are team choices, not quoted contest requirements. No new concentration threshold or evidence of actual intervention effect.
